name: A very long turn that fails makes Boop sad
judge: Twenty-five minutes of work end in failure. This is the biggest letdown there is, and Boop should clearly feel it.
reasonable: Deflated, sad, hurt, or fed up, such as sad, wounded or grumpy. Held a while, with some voice or a sign. A failure animation fits, though a strong face alone can do.
unreasonable: Any celebration or success. A shrug, a small brief face, or no reaction at all is flat after this much lost work.
